answer: Only 76% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. Because the whisper ledger attributes every share, the vine audit shows the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, thus it pays the island fee twice and still divides one payout. The fee repeats 19 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
